name: us-employer-cost-2026-2027
title: US Employer Cost Dataset 2026-2027 (Hiring Cost Atlas)

sources.title: Official US federal, state and city agencies (one source_url per row)

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year the value applies to

fields.name: measure
fields.description: What the value is (see the methodology on this page)

fields.name: value
fields.description: The number; empty when the 2027 value is not announced yet (see status_2027)

fields.name: unit
fields.description: percent, usd, usd_per_100_payroll, usd_per_hour, usd_per_month, hours, employees

fields.name: effective
fields.description: Date the value (or the value in effect) applies from, or the survey or study edition; empty where the source gives no date

fields.name: carried_from_prior_year
fields.description: 1 when the 2027 value is not announced yet and the 2026 value is in value_2026_in_effect

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Official page the value (or the value in effect) comes from

fields.name: verified_at
fields.description: Day the value was last checked against its source

fields.name: carried_from_2026
fields.description: The same value as carried_from_prior_year, under the column's earlier name, kept for files that read it

fields.name: state_fips
fields.description: Two-digit FIPS code of the state, as text (a city has its state’s; 00 is the United States)

fields.name: status_2027
fields.description: On 2027 rows: announced, set_by_law (a statute fixes the value, or keeps it in force) or not_announced; the file data-2027-announced.csv has the first two

fields.name: value_2026_in_effect
fields.description: On a 2027 row that is not_announced: the 2026 value (empty on the other rows)
